data.one_liner: Un-escapes HTML-encoded strings supporting named, decimal, and hexadecimal character references.
data.what_it_does: A Dart library for unescaping HTML-encoded strings. It supports all Named Character References, Decimal Character References, and Hexadecimal Character References.
use_when: You need to decode HTML entities in text scraped from the web or fetched from APIs.
You want to process streams of data containing HTML-escaped characters.
avoid_when: You only need to escape HTML characters instead of decoding them.
You are looking for an HTML parser or DOM manipulation library.
strengths: Supports over 2000 named character references as well as decimal and hexadecimal references.
Offers a small version for reduced code size and increased performance if only common characters are needed.
Can be used as a stream transformer.
weaknesses: Limited to unescaping HTML and does not provide general HTML parsing or DOM creation features.
